Sensitivity of every cycle to each fundamental frequency

Source: R/term_sensitivity.R
term_sensitivity.Rd

Sensitivity of every cycle to each fundamental frequency

Usage

term_sensitivity(
  age_ma = 0,
  delta = 0.01,
  k_yr = NULL,
  fundamentals = c("g1", "g2", "g3", "g4", "g5", "s1", "s3", "s4", "s6", "k"),
  data_dir = NULL
)

Arguments

age_ma

Age in Ma (numeric, single value, 0 to 4429) at which the term periods are computed; the precession constant is taken from astrogeo22 at this age unless k_yr is given. Default=0.

delta

Fractional change applied to each fundamental frequency in turn (numeric, e.g. 0.01 = +1%; may be negative). Default=0.01.

k_yr

Your own precession constant k, as a period in years (numeric, > 0), used instead of the AstroGeo22 value at age_ma; NULL uses the AstroGeo22 value (astrogeo22(age_ma)$p_arcsec). Default=NULL.

fundamentals

Fundamental frequencies to vary, one column of the result each (character vector): any of "g1" to "g9", "s1" to "s9" (La2004 secular frequencies) and "k" (precession constant). Names of a named vector are used as column names. Default=c("g1", "g2", "g3", "g4", "g5", "s1", "s3", "s4", "s6", "k").

data_dir

Folder that contains the data files AstroGeo22.txt and La04gisi.csv (character path); NULL uses the copy installed with the package. Default=NULL.

Value

matrix of percent change in each term's period (rows) per `delta` change in each fundamental (columns), including the precession constant k
